method_config.candidate_selection: within-category robust z-score over all heads; no fixed candidate cap
method_config.matched_null: within source, category, and ordered label-transition pattern; cyclically permute right-side donors among sampled pairs
method_config.AP_test: one-sided source-level sign-flip test on observed-minus-null mean absolute symmetric patch contribution
method_config.CF_test: two-sided source-level sign-flip test on observed-minus-null label-aligned symmetric patch contribution
method_config.final_selection: BH q-value, source-bootstrap 95% confidence interval, bootstrap sign stability, and candidate recurrence across inner folds
method_config.final_head_count: adaptive; no fixed minimum or maximum

attribution_split: within each inner fold, discovery sources only
queue_contract: union raw pair/head interventions across plans; preserve each plan's fold-specific candidate set and source weights
weighting: class/source/case/variant hierarchy; normalized in each training fold
